brief:
A child was thrown from a moving vehicle during an incident involving an armed gang in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The child's mother attempted to flee from the gang's encampment when the incident occurred.

The report identified the gang operative responsible as a member of a criminal organization operating in the territory. Details of the child's condition and the circumstances surrounding the attempted escape remain unclear.
